collection.title: Nissan Vanette 1995 to 2002 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Nissan Vanette 1995 - 2002 model requires a 24" wiper blade for both the drivers passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper.
